Existing rankCars preference curves with separate importance/indifference and confirmed exact evidence. Collaborator direction, 11 November 2026: use more of the allowance among similarly matched eligible cars; five preference-score points defines a revisable similarity band. No retail cash budget. Quote terms remain pinned for the full 7,200-second buddy hold. Demo calibration is revisable, not BMW policy. Collaborator-reviewed option mappings, 11 November: invisible equipment preference at importance 100; desirability weights 0..3. Shared fixed saturation scale (eight desirability points gives 50/100); supporting slider evidence moves five points per reviewed unit, capped at twenty. Unresolved packages use conservative overlapping-capability fallbacks, not inferred contents. Only selected active catalogue configuration/fitted evidence counts. These calibration values are revisable assumptions.

These calibration values are revisable assumptions.
